name: ES Studio
description: Professional Elasticsearch management workbench for DBX.
releaseNotes: 0.5.2: query profiler no longer reports all-zero rows on Elasticsearch 6.x/7.x (compound shard ids are now parsed); query results render one column per mapping field with per-row detail; large clusters (6k+ shards) load through paginated shards/index tables, a leaner overview batch and 60s request timeouts; all form controls share one chrome and focus ring.
